Japanese storybook illustration, simplified botanical shapes, thick soft dark-purple outlines, flat pastel colors, minimal internal details, layered plant heights, rounded organic silhouettes, cozy mobile game aesthetic. A single complete plant, front-facing with a slight three-quarter view, centered, full silhouette visible, generous transparent padding, designed to fit naturally inside a miniature garden diorama. Show exactly 4 and only 4 clearly countable flowering spikes, one for each participant, all rising from one shared base and gently converging without overlapping into a single blob. Palette: warm laptop amber, midnight indigo, award pink, gold, orange. Use flat pastel fills and minimal internal detail.
